description: Na₂B₂S₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.16 Å. There are two inequivalent B³⁺ sites. In the first B³⁺ site, B³⁺ is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one S¹⁻ and two S²⁻ atoms. The B-S bond length is 1.80 Å. There is one shorter (1.77 Å) and one longer (1.83 Å) B-S bond length. In the second B³⁺ site, B³⁺ is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one S¹⁻ and two S²⁻ atoms. The B-S bond length is 1.81 Å. There is one shorter (1.77 Å) and one longer (1.83 Å) B-S bond length. There are two inequivalent S¹⁻ sites. In the first S¹⁻ site, S¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one B³⁺ atom. In the second S¹⁻ site, S¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one B³⁺ atom. There are three inequivalent S²⁻ sites. In the first S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two B³⁺ atoms. In the second S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and one B³⁺ atom. In the third S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and one B³⁺ atom.
